# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Profile and badges

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com (Production)

The badge profile page: level, XP, coin balances, badges and showcase items.

### `GET /api/badge/profile` — Get a badge profile

Auth: optional (`Bearer`)

Returns the profile card (level, XP, coin balances and showcase items) and badges. Without `userId`, returns the authenticated user's own page, including locked badges with their art hidden. With `userId`, returns that user's public page with unlocked badges only.

Authentication is optional. When a bearer token is supplied, the request is associated with that user.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `userId` | query | `string` | no |  |
